change: FastAPI now publishes and enforces the participant-invite reader bounds in OpenAPI; invalid limit/offset values return 422 before the service is called. Typed integer values are forwarded to the existing service validator.
rollback: Revert the route-level Query constraints and focused contract checks; no persisted state or schema changed.
limitations: The checks exercise OpenAPI and in-process request validation only; they do not establish live proxy behavior or tenant authorization.
